page_title: LEE 1-2 AST | Leeds v Aston Villa 23/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) jumps into a tackle and Robert Jones signals a foul. Leeds earn a free kick.
90+3' Wilfried Gnonto (Leeds) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Emiliano Martinez intercepts the ball.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Wilfried Gnonto (Leeds) has received a yellow card for his foul.
88' The ball goes out of play and Leeds have been awarded a corner kick.

88' Pascal Struijk (Leeds) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the bottom left corner, but Emiliano Martinez keeps the ball out.
87' Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul after Lamare Bogarde (Aston Villa) hacks down one of his opponents.
86' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar.
84' The substitution has been made. Lamare Bogarde (Aston Villa) has replaced Youri Tielemans.
84' Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
80' Daniel Farke has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Joel Piroe (Leeds) replacing Brenden Aaronson.
80' Substitution. Wilfried Gnonto (Leeds) has come on for Noah Okafor.
80' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Leeds due to a handball in the build-up play.
79' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was a handball in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Leeds players aren’t happy.
79' Wait! Referee Robert Jones has indicated he is going to review the Leeds goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.

77' It's in the back of the net! Daniel James lines up a shot and his effort takes a deflection off Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) that wrong foots Emiliano Martinez and sends it into the back of the net. It's 1:2.
75' 1 - 2 Goal! Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) sends the free kick shot from the edge of the box. The ball goes into the middle of the goal and ends in the back of the net.
74' A free kick has been awarded to Aston Villa.
74' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pascal Struijk (Leeds) was quite harsh and Robert Jones didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
71' It will be a substitution. Daniel James (Leeds) is ready to enter the pitch as Lukas Nmecha walks off.
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) comes onto the pitch so that Ao Tanaka can be given a rest.
70' Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the right-hand post.
68' Here is a change. John McGinn is going off and Unai Emery gives the last tactical orders to Ross Barkley (Aston Villa).
68' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jadon Sancho (Aston Villa) for Ollie Watkins.
68' John McGinn (Aston Villa) receives a decent pass from Donyell Malen and immediately goes for goal from mid-range. It's a fine strike but the ball goes just over the bar.
67' Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
63' What was Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

58' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper leaps from the ground and makes a stunning save.
58' Aston Villa get a corner.
56' The referee signals a corner kick to Aston Villa.

55' This was a piece of cake for Lucas Perri. Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
54' Sean Longstaff (Leeds) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
53' John McGinn (Aston Villa) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
53' John McGinn (Aston Villa) brings his opponent down. Robert Jones has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Leeds get a free kick.
51' Sean Longstaff (Leeds) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.

48' 1 - 1 Wonderful movement! Donyell Malen is in a good position inside the box but decides to pass the ball to Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa), who keeps his cool and blasts the ball inside the left post. What a finish that is – 1:1.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Emiliano Buendia comes off for Donyell Malen (Aston Villa).
46' Half-time substitution. Unai Emery decided to make a change. Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is replaced by Ian Maatsen.
46' The second half has just started.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Corner kick. Aston Villa will have an opportunity.
45+3' Ao Tanaka (Leeds) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.

45+1' Boubacar Kamara sprays a wonderful pass out to Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause Lucas Perri problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just wide of the right post.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
45' Boubacar Kamara plays a lovely pass into Matty Cash (Aston Villa), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the right post.
41' Jayden Bogle (Leeds) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

39' Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He latches on to a precise pass and fires a decent first-time low shot towards goal from a promising distance, but Emiliano Martinez denies him.
39' Leeds are about to take a corner kick.
36' Noah Okafor (Leeds) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Lukas Nmecha, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
34' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
32' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
29' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is penalised for a foul. Robert Jones had a clear view and blows his whistle.
27' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards wide of the right post.
24' Chance! Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Lukas Nmecha, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the right post.
23' Daniel Farke is forced to make a change. Anton Stach (Leeds) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Ao Tanaka.
23' It doesn’t look good for Anton Stach (Leeds); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
21' The game is interrupted now, Anton Stach (Leeds) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
15' Sean Longstaff (Leeds) makes a slide tackle, but referee Robert Jones blows for a foul.
14' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
12' Sean Longstaff (Leeds) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Aston Villa, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
12' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Robert Jones to decide it wasn’t offside. The relieved Leeds players can finally celebrate.
11' Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
10' Wait! Referee Robert Jones has indicated he is going to review the Leeds goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
10' Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
9' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Leeds players aren’t happy.
8' 1 - 0 Goal! Lukas Nmecha (Leeds) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
7' Leeds win a free kick.
7' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Leeds will have the kick-off.
Robert Jones was nominated as the referee for this game.
